how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-21.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:95795:details:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
rows.quest:95803:obj:0: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:95803:details:0: Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the ⟦E2⟧. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.
rows.quest:95803:details:1: Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
rows.quest:95809:obj:0: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:95809:details:0: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.
rows.quest:95809:details:1: Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.
rows.quest:95810:obj:0: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the ⟦E4⟧ excavation site.
rows.quest:95810:details:0: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'
rows.quest:95810:details:1: Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
rows.quest:95981:obj:0: Slay 8 ⟦E5⟧ Wizards and 8 ⟦E5⟧ Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:95981:details:0: Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin ⟦E6⟧ really are shipping a steady supply of relics from ⟦E5⟧, we must stop them at the source.
rows.quest:95981:details:1: Search the roads around Ambermill for ⟦E5⟧'s wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into ⟦E7⟧ in the first place.
rows.quest:96390:title: Nip 'Em in the Bud
rows.quest:96390:details:0: Dark Iron spies have infiltrated ⟦E8⟧. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.
rows.quest:96390:details:1: Head eastward to ⟦E9⟧'s Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
rows.quest:96390:completion:0: These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.
rows.quest:96390:completion:1: Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
rows.quest:96391:obj:0: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in .
rows.quest:96391:details:0: <The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath ⟦E10⟧ itself.
rows.quest:96391:details:1: You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
rows.quest:96392:title: Farsen's Watch
rows.quest:96392:obj:0: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his farsight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
rows.quest:96392:details:0: Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting ⟦E8⟧ from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.
rows.quest:96392:details:1: If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
rows.quest:96392:completion:0: So ye see now, ⟦1⟧? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.
rows.quest:96392:completion:1: Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
rows.quest:96393:obj:0: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old ⟦E10⟧ and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
rows.quest:96393:details:0: Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old ⟦E10⟧. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults.
rows.quest:96393:details:1: My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard.
rows.quest:96393:details:2: Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
rows.quest:96394:obj:0: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
rows.quest:96394:details:0: Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.
rows.quest:96394:details:1: Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
rows.quest:96395:obj:0: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
rows.quest:96395:details:0: The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.
rows.quest:96395:details:1: Please... help him... help him... rest...
rows.quest:96395:details:2: Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
rows.quest:96403:obj:0: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
rows.quest:96403:details:0: You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.
rows.quest:96403:details:1: I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.
rows.quest:96403:details:2: I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
rows.quest:96408:obj:0: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
rows.quest:96408:details:0: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
rows.quest:96408:details:1: It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
rows.quest:96607:obj:0: Sit near 's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
rows.quest:96607:details:1: Well howdy there, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
rows.quest:96607:details:3: Lok-tar, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
rows.quest:96607:details:5: Greetings, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
rows.quest:96607:details:6: You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
rows.quest:96607:details:7: Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
rows.quest:96627:obj:0: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
rows.quest:96627:details:0: , you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
rows.quest:96627:details:1: I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
rows.quest:96628:obj:0: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
rows.quest:96628:details:0: Wait, . I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.
rows.quest:96628:details:1: My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
rows.quest:96630:obj:0: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
rows.quest:96630:details:0: <The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
rows.quest:96630:details:1: There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
rows.quest:96638:obj:0: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
rows.quest:96638:details:0: More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.
rows.quest:96638:details:1: Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
rows.quest:96652:obj:0: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
rows.quest:96652:details:0: <The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
rows.quest:96652:details:1: There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
rows.quest:96656:details:0: , you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the ⟦E16⟧ so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
rows.quest:96656:details:1: I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by ⟦E15⟧. Go and see what she's doing.
rows.quest:96658:title: Camping 101: ⟦E17⟧
rows.quest:96658:obj:0: Speak with ⟦2⟧ in ⟦3⟧ to learn to become a cook.
rows.quest:96658:details:0: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, ⟦6⟧. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
rows.quest:96658:details:1: ⟦E17⟧'s not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
rows.quest:96658:completion:0: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
rows.quest:96658:completion:1: Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
rows.quest:96658:completion:2: You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
rows.quest:96659:obj:0: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:96659:details:0: Wait, . I have another ask of you, before you leave us.
rows.quest:96659:details:1: There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
rows.quest:96821:obj:0: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern , then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:96821:details:0: We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.
rows.quest:96821:details:1: If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
rows.quest:96822:obj:0: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's ⟦E18⟧, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
rows.quest:96822:details:0: We lost many brave warriors of the ⟦E19⟧ when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.
rows.quest:96822:details:1: Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
rows.quest:96825:obj:0: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
rows.quest:96825:details:0: Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.
rows.quest:96825:details:1: I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
rows.quest:96873:obj:0: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
rows.quest:96873:details:0: The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.
rows.quest:96873:details:1: Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
rows.quest:96876:title: Ukor's Lost Pack
rows.quest:96876:obj:0: Return the pack to Ukor in southern .
rows.quest:96876:details:0: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
rows.quest:96876:completion:0: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
rows.quest:96895:obj:0: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:96895:details:0: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both ⟦E20⟧... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.
rows.quest:96895:details:1: One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
rows.quest:96896:obj:0: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
rows.quest:96896:details:0: Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the ⟦E2⟧ when ⟦E21⟧ attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.
rows.quest:96896:details:1: He might just have been the first ⟦E20⟧ to rediscover how to wield the light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.
rows.quest:96896:details:2: If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...
rows.quest:96897:obj:0: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in .
rows.quest:96897:details:0: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the ⟦E16⟧. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
rows.quest:96898:details:0: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of ⟦E21⟧ bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the ⟦E20⟧ off the map. Both the ⟦E20⟧ and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:96898:details:1: During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath ⟦E21⟧ was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
rows.quest:96899:obj:0: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in .
rows.quest:96899:details:0: You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.
rows.quest:96899:details:1: If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
rows.quest:96984:obj:0: Collect the ⟦E22⟧ Mote in the City of ⟦E5⟧ for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:96984:details:0: You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if ⟦E5⟧ falls, it takes everything with it--including your ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:96984:details:1: So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin ⟦E6⟧ will be too busy to stop you.
rows.quest:96984:details:2: Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
rows.quest:96986:obj:0: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of ⟦E5⟧ for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:96986:details:0: Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin ⟦E6⟧'s nose.
rows.quest:96986:details:1: I care not for the fate of the mage city, , but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we ⟦E20⟧ stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
rows.quest:96987:obj:0: Collect the Founding of ⟦E5⟧ from the City of ⟦E5⟧ for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
rows.quest:96987:details:0: Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into ⟦E5⟧ durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.
rows.quest:96987:details:2: While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.
rows.quest:96987:details:3: Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
rows.quest:96988:obj:0: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of ⟦E5⟧ for Doctor Martin Felben in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:96988:details:0: With the city of ⟦E5⟧ under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.
rows.quest:96988:details:1: Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?
rows.quest:96988:details:2: Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
rows.quest:97220:title: Philmor's Favor
rows.quest:97220:obj:0: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
rows.quest:97220:details:0: Every day this week we've been short dockhands.
rows.quest:97220:details:1: Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?
rows.quest:97220:details:2: Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
rows.quest:97220:completion:0: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
rows.quest:97223:obj:0: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:97223:details:0: All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over ⟦E23⟧, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.
rows.quest:97223:details:1: One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
rows.quest:97225:obj:0: Collect 8 Forgotten ⟦E24⟧ Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:97225:details:0: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.
rows.quest:97225:details:1: The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.
rows.quest:97225:details:2: This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.
rows.quest:97225:details:3: Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
rows.quest:97242:title: Yelmak's Medley
rows.quest:97242:obj:0: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's ⟦E25⟧ and Potions.
rows.quest:97242:details:0: Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.
rows.quest:97242:details:1: He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.
rows.quest:97242:details:2: Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
rows.quest:97242:completion:0: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to ⟦E26⟧. Drinking from ⟦E27⟧ mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.
rows.quest:97242:completion:1: I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
